meta.title: A blank end time cannot be saved
gaps: Verify that no request with a null end time is issued: the schedule-save request path and payload field are not supplied.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that no request with a null end time is issued: the schedule-save request path and payload field are not supplied.

steps.note: Open the create screen to reach scheduling.
Satisfy the prerequisite for opening Schedule.
Open the schedule drawer without committing a schedule.
Confirm the setup drawer is open.
Use a fixed end time rather than a duration.
Clear the end time before attempting to save.

args.reason: Deliberately leave the end time blank; do not repair it with a valid schedule.

steps.note: Require positive evidence that saving the blank end time is refused.
Require validation at the end-time field, not merely a generic toast.
Check that the invalid save did not produce a server error or page crash.
